stem: Sample: If 3 workers complete a task in 8 hours, how long for 6 workers at the same rate?
explanation_en: More workers means less time at the same rate; 6 workers finish in 4 hours.
explanation_fil: Mas maraming workers, mas mabilis — 4 hours ang sagot kung pareho ang rate.

stem: Which sentence uses correct subject-verb agreement?
choice_b: Each applicant has a valid ID.
explanation_en: Each applicant has a valid ID uses a singular verb with a singular subject.
explanation_fil: Tama ang Each applicant has dahil singular ang subject at verb.

stem: All civil servants must uphold integrity. Ana is a civil servant. Therefore Ana must ___ integrity.
explanation_en: If all members of a group must do X and Ana is in the group, Ana must do X.
explanation_fil: Kung lahat dapat mag-uphold at si Ana ay kasama, dapat din niyang i-uphold.

stem: Which branch of the Philippine government enacts national laws?
explanation_en: The Legislative branch (Congress) enacts laws under the 1987 Constitution.
explanation_fil: Ang Legislative branch (Kongreso) ang gumagawa ng batas.
